verdict.rationale: The skill set is distributed from a shared GitHub repo through the open `skills` CLI, with an interactive mode, a non-interactive all-skills install, and single-skill installs. It also ships as a single plugin through a Claude marketplace.json and Cursor/portable plugin metadata, and `yy skills install/update` keeps all agent copies on the latest compatible stable release. Missing for 10: evidence of project-scoped files committed to a team repo or team-wide pinning/enforcement, guidance for distributing a lead's own custom skill set rather than this fixed pack, and independent hands-on corroboration.
